item.title: Pull request #2993 created
item.description:
2991 Rules for Untrusted Functions (part 1)

Fix #2991

Marks functions that access external resources as security-sensitive; adds the concept that these are evaluated in sandbox mode if the function is referenced in a (statically) untrusted context; defines the rules for each security-sensitive function when executed in sandboxed mode.

Still to do: similar treatment of functions defined in XSLT and the File module; extra words in the XQuery spec on import module and import schema, and similar constructs in XSLT, and xsl:evaluate.
